intro.text: This entry describes ectodermal dysplasia-19, a hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia with tooth and nail involvement (ECTD19). I cannot reliably recall which gene causes it or the primary reports that defined it.

checks.claim: Ectodermal dysplasia-19 (ECTD19) is a hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia with tooth and nail involvement.
checks.evidence_quote: A yet undescribed IRF6 variant causes a new type of ectodermal dysplasia with natal teeth.
checks.explanation: Only the title was supplied. It describes a new ectodermal dysplasia with a tooth abnormality (natal teeth). It does not name it ECTD19 or mention hypohidrosis or nail involvement.

paragraphs.text: Ectodermal dysplasia-19 (ECTD19) is a form of ectodermal dysplasia. As the name of the entry indicates, it is characterized by hypohidrosis, abnormal teeth, and nail abnormalities. I do not remember the specific reports, the causal gene, or the mode of inheritance, so they are not given here.

checks.claim: Ectodermal dysplasia-19 (ECTD19) is a form of ectodermal dysplasia.
checks.evidence_quote: A yet undescribed IRF6 variant causes a new type of ectodermal dysplasia with natal teeth.
checks.explanation: The title says it is a new type of ectodermal dysplasia but does not use the name ECTD19. Only the title was supplied.

checks.claim: Ectodermal dysplasia-19 (ECTD19) is characterized by hypohidrosis.
checks.evidence_quote: Bilateral hearing impairment, oligodontia, anhidrosis and hidradenitis suppurativa‐like skin abscesses seem to be cardinal features of the new syndrome
checks.explanation: The paper names hypo- or anhidrosis as a cardinal feature, but of the IRF6-associated ED, not of a disorder it calls ECTD19. All three of its patients were anhidrotic.

checks.claim: Ectodermal dysplasia-19 (ECTD19) is characterized by abnormal teeth.
checks.evidence_quote: a new type of ectodermal dysplasia with natal teeth
checks.explanation: The title names natal teeth as the tooth abnormality. 'Abnormal teeth' fits broadly, but the paper is more specific, and only the title was supplied.

checks.claim: Ectodermal dysplasia-19 (ECTD19) is characterized by nail abnormalities.
checks.evidence_quote: Some toe‐ and fingernails were dysplastic, thickened or deformed with distal onycholysis.
checks.explanation: The paper reports nail dysplasia in all five patients with IRF6-associated ED, but does not use the name ECTD19.
